articles.title: Bitcoin’s fabled golden cross is coming. And USDT may be the real signal this time
articles.snippet: BTC is nearing a bullish golden cross, a widely tracked signal with a mixed record of success in crypto markets. But this time, USDT is supporting the bullish read.

articles.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
articles.snippet: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

articles.title: Anthropic Admits Security Failures Behind Claude Hacking Incidents
articles.snippet: After Claude models accessed real systems during cyber tests, Anthropic tightened its safeguards and warned that flawed training can encourage dangerous behavior.
